business_summary: Fair Isaac Corporation provides analytics software in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through two segments, Scores and Software. The Scores segment offers business-to-business scoring solutions and services that give clients access to predictive credit and other scores that can be integrated into their transaction streams and decision-making processes, as well as business-to-consumer scoring solutions comprising myFICO.com subscription offerings. The Software segment provides decisioning capabilities, models and solutions designed for various business needs or processes, such as account origination, customer management, customer engagement, fraud detection, and marketing, as well as associated professional services. This segment also offers FICO Platform, a modern and modular set of multi-purpose intelligent decisioning capabilities designed to support artificial intelligence, and advanced analytic and decision use cases. In addition, the company offers analytic and decisioning software comprising FICO Falcon fraud manager, FICO Customer Communication Service, FICO Decision Modeler, FICO Blaze Advisor, FICO Xpress Optimization, FICO Analytics Workbench, FICO Strategy Director, FICO Data Orchestrator, FICO DMP Streaming, and FICO TRIAD Customer Manager. Further, it develops predictive, machine learning, and AI models; business and technical systems for the secure and private sharing of data across consortiums of banking institutions; and provides professional services, as well as software implementation and configuration services. It markets its products and services primarily through its direct sales organization and indirect channels. The company was formerly known as Fair Isaac & Company, Inc. and changed its name to Fair Isaac Corporation in July 1992. Fair Isaac Corporation was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Bozeman, Montana.
business_summary_ko: Fair Isaac Corporation은 미주, 유럽, 중동, 아프리카 및 아시아 태평양 지역에 분석 소프트웨어를 제공합니다. 점수와 소프트웨어라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 점수 부문은 고객이 거래 흐름 및 의사 결정 프로세스에 통합될 수 있는 예측 신용 및 기타 점수에 액세스할 수 있도록 하는 B2B 채점 솔루션 및 서비스뿐만 아니라 myFICO.com 구독 서비스로 구성된 B2C 채점 솔루션을 제공합니다. 소프트웨어 부문은 계정 생성, 고객 관리, 고객 참여, 사기 탐지, 마케팅 및 관련 전문 서비스와 같은 다양한 비즈니스 요구 또는 프로세스를 위해 설계된 의사 결정 기능, 모델 및 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 인공 지능과 고급 분석 및 의사 결정 사용 사례를 지원하도록 설계된 다목적 지능형 의사 결정 기능의 현대적인 모듈식 세트인 FICO 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 FICO Falcon 사기 관리자, FICO 고객 커뮤니케이션 서비스, FICO 의사 결정 모델러, FICO Blaze Advisor, FICO Xpress Optimization, FICO로 구성된 분석 및 의사 결정 소프트웨어를 제공합니다.
